note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; the rule text is the author's illustrative text, not a statement of any law. Only supplied relationships are drawn; a causal style appears only when the author supplies it; the hypothetical's outcome is never shown.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Fictional delivery: set and events are shared by both takes; only circumstance cel B changes (flag from the porch bench to the window sill). Relation set–events, sequences events→A and events→B, relations A–rule and B–rule; the magnifier enlarges cel B.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a fictional equipment return (flag from the wall parcel box to the bench below). Different supplied relationships — cel A is not related to the rule, the events reach cel B through a supplied communication link — a different traversal order, and the magnifier enlarges the events cel instead.

facts.title: Evening delivery of a parcel at number 9 of fictional Linden Street
events: A courier from a fictional delivery service arrives at the garden at 18:10
The courier carries parcel number 7 all the way up to the house front
The courier leaves the parcel there and steps back towards the garden

rules.title: House notice number 2 of the residents' association (illustrative)
conditions: A parcel addressed to a resident of the house is left for that resident
at a place that was agreed in advance with the resident concerned
before seven o'clock in the evening of the delivery day

circumstance.label: The exact place where the courier finally leaves the parcel
circumstance.baseText: on the wooden bench under the porch roof
circumstance.altText: on the stone sill of the front window instead

issues: Was the stone window sill ever agreed with the resident as a place for parcels?
assumptions: Every other event happens exactly as in the base run of the scene
The courier's route and timing are the same in both takes

elements.label: The set: house front and garden, both takes
The courier's events, same order in both

relationLabels.sequence: followed by, in exactly the same order
relationLabels.causal: causal link, as supplied by the author
